name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Ballistic Helmet BH-9 'Ironhead'
product_name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Ballistic Helmet BH-9 'Ironhead'
description: A full-coverage tactical helmet with integrated comms, HUD visor, NBC filter, and NIJ Level IV ballistic protection. The BH-9 uses a composite of boron carbide ceramic and ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene to defeat rifle-caliber threats while remaining under 2 kg. The integrated visor provides thermal, low-light, and AR overlay modes, and the helmet's padded interior includes impact-absorbing gel that reduces concussive force transmission by 80%. It has become the standard-issue helmet for corporate security forces across GLMZ.
story_hooks: A BH-9's HUD recorded the wearer's final moments during an ambush — the footage has become evidence in a corporate liability case.
Modified BH-9 helmets with removed IFF transponders are being sold to non-aligned combatants who want the protection without the corporate tracking.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, angular full-coverage tactical helmet with a pronounced forward-swept visor. The design prioritizes protection without sacrificing visibility—the visor wraps nearly 180 degrees around the wearer's face. The helmet has a distinctly modern military aesthetic with subtle corpo-sleek refinement; it's aggressive but not brutal.
physical_description.dimensions: Approximately 28 cm tall, 24 cm wide, 22 cm deep. Medium/large adult head-sized form factor.
physical_description.weight_description: Handheld-light; under 2 kg with integrated systems. Designed for all-day wear without neck fatigue.
physical_description.primary_material: Composite boron carbide ceramic faceplate and crown with ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene backing layers. Matte black and gunmetal base with reinforced impact zones.
physical_description.finish: Textured matte ceramic on strike surfaces; satin gunmetal accents on structural ribbing. Visor has a faint amber anti-reflective coating visible at oblique angles.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep matte black primary body. Gunmetal gray reinforcement ribs and mounting brackets. Amber/gold tinted visor with subtle green AR reticle glow when powered. Minimal corpo branding in matte gray.
physical_description.interface_elements: Integrated HUD visor with multi-mode display (thermal/low-light/AR toggles via temple-mounted haptic controls). Two recessed buttons on left side (comms cycle, overlay select). Bone-conduction speaker grilles visible at temples and rear neck. Rebreather port on lower left jaw with NBC filter cartridge (magnetic-snap fit). Micro-LED status indicators (power, comms, filter saturation) along rear neck band. Modular headset connector jack at right temple.
distinctive_features: Panoramic wraparound visor with faint prismatic distortion pattern visible in certain light—signature AR display tech
Integrated thermal imaging bloom visible as faint red pinpoints behind the visor when active
Reinforced cheekbone and jaw guards with subtle ribbed texture for impact dispersion
Articulated neck guard with articulated ceramic-lined rear section
Hexagonal vent ports on crown for heat dissipation, arranged in Arcturus Defense Solutions logo pattern
Amber pneumatic pressure relief valve on left side—indicates NBC filter status
Fine toolmark patterns on ceramic surfaces from precision CNC finishing
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ARCTURUS DEFENSE SOLUTIONS embossed in sans-serif block letters on rear crown. Model designation 'BH-9 IRONHEAD' printed in small white text on right temple. GLMZ Regulatory Commission NIJ Level IV certification stamp on interior left band. Serial number etched into internal padding.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn with minor wear patterns on forward visor rim and impact zones; scratches and dust streaks from field use are common. Rebreather cartridge frequently replaced/dirty. Status LEDs visible but dimmed in normal light. Visor often has fingerprint/dust residue when not freshly cleaned.
